architecture: locked synthetic plain FlowBlock graphs built through production BlockGraph APIs (newBlock/addEdge, structureLoops entry state); no AddrSpace, no Funcdata, no PcodeOps — CollapseStructure is driven directly on the graph copy, mirroring ActionBlockStructure cc:2177-2180
compiler_spec: not applicable: no Funcdata, no prototype model, no symbols (pure BlockGraph fixture)

analysis_options.entrypoint: CollapseStructure::collapseAll on structureLoops-labeled synthetic graphs (Rugra: CollapseStructure::collapse_all, the faithful 5-step path); TraceDAG/selectGoto/markExitsAsGotos/clipExtraRoots all live inside the driver
analysis_options.prestate: per-case fresh BlockGraph, edges added in a fixed creation order; the spanning tree + irreducible + loop labels are established by structureLoops exactly as the oracle run() does
analysis_options.observation: per case: final top-level component list (order + type + interior-goto + out-edge labels/targets), the full structure tree (component types in identifyInternal child order, gototarget names, gotoout/flip flags), and every original block's surviving out-edge labels + flip + listed flags

input_manifest.canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON with sorted keys and compact separators over architecture, compiler_spec, analysis_options, and cases
cases: loop_break_marked_goto: while+break CFG (b0 2-out {body,exit}, b1 2-out {body,exit}, b2 back-edge, b3 ret) — the oracle folds the break into a while-condition (list > whiledo > condition{b0,b1} + b2) with ZERO goto marks
diamond_if_recovery: if/else diamond + continuation — properif{cond,tc,fc} cat-merged into a single list, ZERO goto marks
while_guard_direction: loop body on the fall-through (false) edge — ruleBlockWhileDo cc:1540 negates: head flip=1 (BOTH sides match)
dowhile_guard_direction: self back-edge on slot 0 — ruleBlockDoWhile cc:1566-1569 negates: flip=1 (BOTH sides match, full tree matches)
consumed_edge_cleared: straight chain collapses into one list component (tree matches both sides)
irreducible_goto_cascade: classic two-entry pair — cascade converges; goto targets b2 and b3 plus gotoout bits MATCH on both sides

observation_schema.format: per case: 'case <name>', 'list=...', one 'cN type=... gotoout=... out=[slot:flags->target]' line plus an indented 'tree cN:' block per top-level component, one 'bN out=[slot:flags] flip=. listed=.' line per original block, then 'end'
observation_schema.normalization: block identity prints as creation-order names (bN) / top-level list positions (cN), never pointers; edge labels print as semantic flag letters (g l d i t f c b x, '-'); consumed-vertex IN-DEGREE is normalized OUT on both sides (Ghidra selfIdentify re-points/dedups external in-edges while keeping sibling-internal ones, Rugra's install-in-place model clears consumed in-edges — BLOCKSTRUCT-IDENTIFY-BOUNDARY-0001, not goto-cascade semantics); BlockGoto children are not dumped on either side (Rugra's newBlockGoto wraps in place, documented in both fixtures)

coverage.goto_cascade_convergence: MATCH: the cascade terminates on every case (the previous port spun forever on diamond_if_recovery); selectGoto marks one edge at a time with a full collapseInternal between marks exactly as cc:1889-1892; irreducible_goto_cascade picks the same goto targets (b2, b3) and the same gotoout bits as the oracle
coverage.condition_body_recovery: MATCH: loop_break_marked_goto forms whiledo > condition{b0,b1} (the OR fold) exactly as the oracle — no orphaned CBRANCH, no bare conditional statements; diamond_if_recovery forms properif{cond,tc,fc}
coverage.guard_direction: MATCH: while_guard_direction head flip=1 (cc:1540 negation, previously the negation was computed inverted and then discarded) and dowhile_guard_direction flip=1 (cc:1566-1569, previously omitted) on both sides
coverage.tracedag_select_bad_edge: MATCH-by-construction on the covered graphs: siblingedge comparison direction (cc:621), common-ancestor distance (cc:524-536), the (exitproto, bp, pathout) group order (cc:635-651), terminal-traces-stay-active (cc:670/844-851), and removeTrace's pathout shift (cc:673-686) are all exercised with zero spurious marks on cases 1-5
coverage.dead_block_determination: MATCH: consumed blocks leave the top-level list and their edges drop out of rule matching on both sides (Rugra's DEAD sweep == Ghidra's incremental identifyInternal list compaction)
coverage.top_level_merge_shape: MISMATCH → BLOCKSTRUCT-IDENTIFY-BOUNDARY-0001: cases 1/3 wrap whiledo in an extra infloop (the WhileDo component's false-exit boundary edge is mis-captured by Rugra's install-in-place identify_internal), case 2 stays split as properif+list where the oracle cat-merges into one list (stale in-edges on the merge block from unconsumed DEAD predecessors), case 6 splits into three properifs where the oracle nests list/dowhile. All are boundary-edge rehoming/dedup gaps in identify_internal (Ghidra block.cc:893-960 selfIdentify+dedup), NOT goto-selection differences
coverage.consumed_vertex_edge_retention: MISMATCH → BLOCKSTRUCT-IDENTIFY-BOUNDARY-0001: Ghidra keeps consumed vertices' own out edges (with labels, e.g. b2 keeps its lb back edge) while Rugra clears them; in-degree already normalized out
